test_title: PYST 14: SSC MTS - English (Held on: 20 Oct 2021 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate word to fill in the blank.**

Did you visit ________ Nehru Planetarium in Delhi during the eclipse?
solution: The correct answer is '**the**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate article for the given blank is '**the**'. • The given sentence is referring to a specific place which is** 'Nehru Planetarium of Delhi'**. • *Example: **The dog** that bit me ran away.* • Hence, we have to use the definite article '**the**' here. **Correct Sentence:__** *Did you visit **the** Nehru Planetarium in Delhi during the eclipse?* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **__Hinglish__** • दिए गए रिक्त स्थान के लिए सबसे उपयुक्त लेख '**the**' है। • दिया गया वाक्य एक विशिष्ट स्थान की बात कर रहा है जो **'Nehru Planetarium of Delhi'** है। • *Example: **The dog** that bit me ran away.* • इसलिए, हमें यहां **definite article** '**the**' का उपयोग करना होगा। 39:T519, The correct answer is** 'To disagree strongly'.**
